notes.title: Myth Bearer V1.21 Update
notes.content:
Updated Myth Bearer to V1.21.

Changes include:

- Added a room reset feature, press R to reset the current room and undo small mistakes.
- Some minor bug fixes and an engine version upgrade.

notes.title: New Game Coming Soon: Deep Rune
notes.content:
Hi there, been a while! If you didn't know already, I am working on a spiritual successor to Myth Bearer called Deep Rune. Deep Rune is pretty much Myth Bearer as a side scroller and is based on Norse mythology, well there might be more to it than that. ;)

Be sure to wishlist Deep Rune to be notified of the full release, which is in 6 weeks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631780/Deep_Rune/
